leads.title: Goodridge v. Department of Public Health - Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex marriage; first U.S. state to grant marriage licenses to same-sex couples in 2004.
leads.detail: SJC ruling on November 18, 2003 that it was unconstitutional under state Constitution to restrict marriage to heterosexual couples; 180 days to enact laws; Governor Mitt Romney ordered town clerks to begin issuing certificates beginning May 17, 2004. No URL in text.

leads.title: Commonwealth v. Balthazar (1974) - Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court
leads.documents: Legality of same-sex sexual activity; inapplicability of sodomy statute to private consensual adult conduct.
leads.detail: 1974 ruling that statute prohibiting 'any unnatural and lascivious act with another person' was inapplicable to 'private, consensual conduct of adults'; permanently enjoins Mass. Gen. Laws sections 34 and 35 alongside Lawrence v. Texas. No URL in text.

leads.title: Massachusetts Gender Identity Anti-Discrimination Law - Public Accommodations (2016) and Ballot Initiative (2018)
leads.documents: Transgender anti-discrimination machinery in employment, housing, credit, union practices and public accommodations; voter retention.
leads.detail: Senate 33-4 on May 12, 2016; House 117-36 on July 7, 2016; signed by Gov. Charlie Baker effective Oct 1, 2016; prior law Nov 23, 2011 effective July 1, 2012 covered employment/housing/credit but not public accommodations; retained Nov 6, 2018 by 67.8% to 32.2% - first statewide ballot question of its kind. No URL in text.

leads.title: Executive Order by Governor Deval Patrick - Feb 17, 2011
leads.documents: State-government enforcement of transgender employment protections.
leads.detail: Executive order banning discrimination on part of state or its contractors against transgender employees of state Government. No URL in text.

leads.title: Barrett v. Fontbonne Academy - Massachusetts Superior Court
leads.documents: Enforcement of sexual orientation/gender anti-discrimination law against religious-affiliated employer.
leads.detail: Complaint filed Jan 29, 2014 with Massachusetts Commission Against Discrimination via GLAD after 2013 withdrawal of food service manager offer due to same-sex marriage; Judge Douglas H. Wilkins ruled Dec 16, 2015 Academy violated state anti-discrimination laws. No URL in text.

leads.title: H140 - Massachusetts Conversion Therapy Ban
leads.documents: Ban on conversion therapy practices on LGBT minors.
leads.detail: House passed June 2018 137-14 but failed Senate; House passed H140 March 13, 2019 147-8; Senate with amendments March 28, 2019 34-0; enacted April 4, 2019; signed by Gov. Charlie Baker April 8, 2019 effective immediately; state became 16th to ban. No URL in text.

leads.title: Massachusetts Gender Healthcare Protections Law - July 2022
leads.documents: Reaffirmed gender healthcare protections codified in legislation (shield law).
leads.detail: Extensive bill passed both houses of Massachusetts General Court July 2022; signed by Governor; went into effect immediately due to emergency clause bypassing usual 90-day period. No URL in text.

leads.title: Massachusetts RMV Gender X Policy and FY25 Budget Birth Certificate Law
leads.documents: Legal gender recognition for non-binary people on IDs, driver licences, birth certificates and marriage certificates.
leads.detail: RMV upgraded software Nov 2019 to include non-binary 'gender X' effective immediately by internal regulation; Senate passed birth certificate X bill Sept 2021; signed as part of FY25 budget July 29, 2024 - allows X on birth certificate, enshrines X on driver's license, allows amending marriage certificate. Sex reassignment surgery not required. No URL in text.

leads.title: An Act Protecting Personal Security - Signed Nov 25, 2025
leads.documents: Name-change privacy machinery relevant to trans safety.
leads.detail: Signed by Gov. Maura Healey Nov 25, 2025; keeps name changes confidential and removes longstanding public notice requirement except when court orders it. No URL in text.

leads.title: Massachusetts Hate Crime Law and Hate Crimes Reporting Act (1990)
leads.documents: Hate-crime enforcement and reporting machinery covering sexual orientation and gender identity.
leads.detail: 1983 hate crime legislation added sexual orientation June 1996; gender identity added effective July 1, 2012; 1990 Act created Crime Reporting Unit in State Police to collect/summarize/report to Attorney General and legislative committees; 1991 Governor's Task Force on Hate Crimes for regulations, training, data. No URL in text.
